verdict.rationale: Disputes and chargebacks are a fair axis for a payment processor, but nothing in the pack documents a dispute or chargeback API, deadline fields, or evidence submission. SumUp's webhook docs say notifications are limited to checkout status changes. Its refund API, MCP server and Agent Toolkit are adjacent features and do not show dispute monitoring or evidence drafting.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor dispute deadlines via API or webhooks and draft evidence responses for my review
